newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, German KfW bank sign DM30 mln loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, German KfW bank sign DM30 mln loan deal.

text.p: The Croatian Bank for Reconstruction and Development (HBOR) said on Thursday it had signed an accord for a 30 million German mark loan with German bank Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau (KfW).
It said in a statement the funds are intended to spur small and medium-sized private business, but mentioned no terms.
The loan represents an expansion of HBOR's existing credit lines of up to 400,000 marks that KfW helped it create in 1994.
HBOR has been granting four to seven year loans, with a grace period of two years, to private entrepreneurs who are investing in modernisation and expansion.
The state bank recently cut lending rates for private businesses to 10 from a previous 13 percent a year. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
